detail.longDescription: NemoClaw’s AI can be poisoned through a browser tab ⚠️ Critical DNS rebinding flaw in Nvidia's NemoClaw lets attackers gain unauthenticated access to local Ollama servers via malicious websites. Attackers can inject persistent malicious instructions into chat templates undetected. Nvidia patched non-Windows systems, but this highlights the need for stronger authentication and network security in local AI server configs. https://www. csoonline.com/article/4214156/ nemoclaws-ai-can-be-poisoned-through-a-browser-tab.html # AI # MachineLearning # Cybersecurity
